text:
marta: FYI Ivan handed in his resignation today. Last official day 2026-06-04 (two weeks notice). We need to coordinate: access cutoff, equipment return from Prague, final payout + commission proration, and benefits wrapup. Rachel, any immediate handover notes?

rachel: Thanks. Ivan will lead the vector-search perf work through Fri 2026-05-30, then we have a handoff doc and a 90-min walkthrough scheduled Mon 2026-06-01 09:00 CEST. Hell keep read access to infra repos for 48h after deprovision for the handoff.

ivan: Correct. I can pack laptop and drop at the courier or hand to onsite partner. Prefer courier pick-up to avoid losing time. Ive uploaded runbook to /docs/offboard/ivan-handoff.md and pushed final PRs.

marta: Great. Quick checklist Im assigning: - it-team: SSO + cloud keys - comp-admin: final pay & commission proration - benefits: coverage end date + options for continuing employer top-up in Czech Republic - logistics-bot: courier label & customs docs - rachel: confirm repos to transfer/maintain.

it-team: We'll schedule phased offboard: lock prod creds immediately at EOD 2026-06-04, disable workstation login 2026-06-05 08:00 CEST, and run GitHub org removal 2026-06-07 08:00 CEST. Please confirm any exceptions. Command we run: `hr-offboard --user ivan --phase fast-lock,workstation-disable,org-remove-48h`

rachel: OK to keep org read-only for 48h; please do not remove SRE oncall token until handoff recorded.

comp-admin: For commissions, we need sales confirmation of deals closed dates. Ivan: any deals still pending?

ivan: I have one referral credit that posted on 2026-04-15 and a contract renewal tied to a Q2 milestone scheduled for 2026-06-10 (post-departure)  not eligible. The referral payout should be included.

comp-admin: We'll pro-rate recurring commission segments by days active in quarter per policy. I'll DM the calc but the final payout will be on the next payroll run after 2026-06-04.

benefits: Czech medical top-up is handled via local vendor (local insurer). Coverage end date will be last active day 2026-06-04. We can offer bridging for up to 2 months for top-up via monthly invoice to ex-employee. You will get the offboarding packet with steps and required forms.

ivan: Do I need to opt-in to bridging now or can I sign post-termination?

benefits: You can opt in within 30 days after termination. We'll include the step-by-step and an estimate of monthly cost in the email.

logistics-bot: Draft label ready for Prague -> Redwood Returns (US). Please confirm HS code and declared value. Suggested: HS 8471.30, value EUR 950 (company book value). Include export CN22 and marking "Company asset - no commercial value". RMA: RMA-0626-114.

ivan: Value and HS OK. Note: laptop has company sticker removed for privacy.

it-team: Security wipe checklist: 1) confirm encrypted backup to company S3 \u2014 ivan to mark done 2) remove SSH keys and API tokens 3) reassign service accounts 4) factory reset w/ disk encryption disabled once asset in transit. Post device serial in thread.

ivan: Backed up to encrypted bucket `s3://redwood-offboards/ivan-2026-06-04` and started token revocations. Serial: SN-PRG-48291.

marta: Offboard bot reminder: please complete exit interview form. Ivan, do you prefer async written feedback or 30-min call?

ivan: 30-min call is fine. Wed 2026-06-03 10:00 CEST works.

offboard-bot: Exit interview scheduled 2026-06-03 10:00 CEST. Link to form: https://hr.redwood/exit/ivan-2467001234

logistics-bot: Courier pickup booked for 2026-06-05 11:00 CEST. Tracking: PRG987654321CZ. Export docs attached in ticket.

comp-admin: Commission proration calculation DM sent to ivan. Final payout scheduled for payroll on 2026-06-18.

marta: Thanks all. Summary: it-team runs phased offboard (prod lock 6/4, workstation disable 6/5, org remove 6/7), comp-admin handles pay/commission, benefits sends local continuation options, logistics handles pickup. Rachel to confirm repo transfer list in thread once done. Please reply here when each step completed. :white_check_mark:

rachel: Transferred ownership for repos `vector-search`, `infra-observability` to team account `team-sre-maintainers`. Left `ml-experiments` as archived with read access for 48h.

it-team: Phased offboard executed. Run ID: off-246700-01. Prod creds locked 2026-06-04T17:05:22Z.

logistics-bot: Device received at Returns on 2026-06-08 09:12 UTC. Asset inspected, checksum matched, serial SN-PRG-48291. RMA closed.

comp-admin: Final payout processed. Payroll confirmation: funds sent 2026-06-18.

marta: Closing thread once Ivan's exit interview complete and we confirm benefits opt-in window noted. Thanks team.

ivan: Exit interview done. Thank you all for the support.
